_comment: Expected values for one customer. Copy per customer. Any key you omit yields UNKNOWN for that check, never PASS — that is deliberate.
_dkim_note: Selectors come from the mailbox host's DKIM setup page. Without them DKIM cannot be checked at all, and the report will say so rather than pass.
_dmarc_note: Record what you actually configured. p=none is monitoring, not enforcement; if you set none, expect none, and know the check is confirming a monitor and not protection.
